summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the title formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on legacy Windows via detect_legacy_windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Not verified: pytest, mypy, and Black were not run, so the widened union's mypy result is unconfirmed.
